case.title: Unsaving from My saved news removes the item immediately
preconditions: Article 'Take the next step in your development at UKG' is already saved for the logged-in user

steps.targetDescription: Verify target saved item is present
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-list'] li:has(a:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG'))

steps.targetDescription: Unsave the item from Saved list
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-list'] li:has(a:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')) [data-testid='bookmark-toggle']

steps.targetDescription: Item is removed from Saved list immediately
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-list'] li:has(a:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG'))

steps.targetDescription: Return to homepage to verify unsaved state on card
Scroll to target article card on homepage
steps.locatorHint: article:has(h3:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG'))
article:has(h3:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')) [data-testid='bookmark-toggle']
